_source: DOMINION slice D25 (Claude API draft §5.2; mockup a10 'Chatter, news and the Hero'). Written offline lines: crew chatter by trait and topic, the weekly Ledger news, extra Hero taunt / Disillusion lines and traitors' parting lines. Rotom only adds to these. Tokens: {name} speaker, {other} the one they answer, {gone} who left, {hero} the Hero, {region}, {memory} a remembered moment, {day} its day, {ace} the Hero's partner, {at} where the Hero is, {team} a rival team.

quiet: Quiet night. Good. The Boss earned one.
I'll take first watch. I always do.
win: Told you the Boss had a plan. Always does.
Clean job. That's what happens when we stick together.
loss: We get them back. Together. Nobody walks alone in this crew.
Bad night. Doesn't change who we follow.
gone: {gone} walked out on the Boss. I won't forget that.
{gone}'s gone. More room at the table for the ones who stay.
hero: Let {hero} come. They'll have to get through me first.
{hero} can have the whole region cheering. We've got the Boss.
heat: Cops on every corner. I'll stand at the door all night if I have to.
Heat's up. We keep our heads down and our word good.

quiet: Quiet night means nobody got paid. I hate quiet nights.
Counting coins again. Still not enough coins.
win: Good haul. When do we split it?
That's the sound of money. My favourite song.
loss: We lost the take? Somebody's paying for that, and it isn't me.
A whole night for nothing. Not even a Nugget.
gone: {gone} quit? Good. Their cut is our cut now.
{gone} left. Did anyone check the till?
hero: {hero} costs us money every time they show up.
I hear there's a price on {hero}'s cap. I'm just saying.
heat: Heat this high is bad for business. Very bad for business.
Every cop out there is a fine waiting to happen.

quiet: Why did the Psyduck cross the road? Nobody knows. Nobody ever knows.
Slow night. I counted the ceiling tiles. Forty. Lucky number.
win: Did you see their face? I'm framing that face.
Easiest job ever. Ten out of ten, would rob again.
loss: So that went great. In the bad way.
Look on the bright side: there isn't one. Ha.
gone: {gone} sang like a Chatot. Told you they were soft.
{gone} left without saying goodbye. Rude. Also, they owe me ₽20.
hero: {hero}'s hat is bigger than their brain. I said it.
Knock knock. Who's there? {hero}. Run.
heat: So many cops outside I'm thinking of charging them rent.
Heat's up! Free sauna. You're welcome.

quiet: Too quiet. I want to break something.
Nothing happened tonight and I'm mad about it.
win: THAT's how you do it! Who's next?
They never saw it coming. I wanted them to.
loss: Next time I go in first. No more sneaking.
We got beat. I'm still shaking, and not from fear.
gone: If I see {gone} again, they'd better run.
{gone} walked out? Say that name again and I walk out after them.
hero: Put me in front of {hero}. Just once. Please.
{hero} thinks they're tough. I'll show them tough.
heat: Let the cops come. I've been waiting all week.
Heat, heat, heat. I say we turn it up.

quiet: Quiet is good. Quiet means nobody's chasing me.
I heard a noise. It was me. Never mind.
win: We did it and nobody got hurt? I need to sit down.
Good job. Can we never do that again?
loss: I knew it. I knew it! I said it would go wrong!
I hid in a bin for an hour. Don't tell anyone.
gone: {gone} left... maybe they were the smart one.
If {gone} can walk away, can I? Kidding. Mostly.
hero: {hero} is in town? I'm staying in the back room.
Has anyone seen {hero}? No? Good. Let's keep it that way.
heat: So many cops. So many. I'm sleeping under the desk.
Every siren is for me. I just know it.

quiet: Every quiet night is a night closer to the Boss's world.
I polished the emblem again. It deserves it.
win: Another step on the path. The Boss sees further than all of us.
The region bends. As it should.
loss: A setback is a lesson. The Boss will make it mean something.
The doubters will say we're finished. We are just beginning.
gone: {gone} never believed. Let the faithful close ranks.
{gone} chose the easy road. History forgets the easy road.
hero: {hero} fights for a world that's already ending.
{hero} is a question. The Boss is the answer.
heat: Let them watch. Let them see what loyalty looks like.
The police serve the old order. It won't last.

quiet: A quiet night is wasted on a talent like mine.
Nobody's talking about us tonight. That's a problem.
win: You're welcome, everyone.
Write my name in the report. Spell it right.
loss: That wasn't my fault. Check the report.
I don't lose. I take a short break from winning.
gone: {gone} couldn't handle this crew. Not everyone can.
{gone} left? Who? Exactly.
hero: {hero} is famous because nobody's met me yet.
When I beat {hero}, I want a parade.
heat: Of course they're watching. Have you seen us?
Wanted posters. Finally, some recognition.

quiet: Quiet. I checked the locks twice anyway.
No news is the best news we get around here.
win: Good result. Now we lie low for a day.
It worked. Let's not get greedy.
loss: We moved too fast. We always move too fast.
I said wait for the patrol to pass. I did say it.
gone: {gone} knows where the back door is. We change the locks tonight.
With {gone} gone, we change every plan they saw.
hero: {hero} wins because they plan. We should plan more.
Track {hero} before {hero} tracks us.
heat: Heat's too high. I'd skip a night if it were up to me.
Every job now is twice the risk. Count it.

quiet: Did you hear about the Gym Leader's new haircut? I heard.
Nothing happened, which is suspicious. Something always happens.
win: Everyone in town's talking about us. I made sure of it.
I heard the shop owner cried. Big tears. True story.
loss: Don't worry, I already know who talked. Ask me later.
Word is, someone tipped them off. Word is usually me.
gone: I know exactly why {gone} left. Want to hear? You do.
{gone} was meeting someone at the Pokémon Center. Every night. Just saying.
hero: {hero} had three Potions and a sandwich for lunch. I have sources.
My cousin's friend saw {hero} crying at a Gym. Probably.
heat: The cops know us by name now. Some of them by nickname.
Officer Jenny's sister's barber says the heat is all about us.

quiet: Quiet's fine. People aren't.
win: Job's done. I'm going.
Worked. Don't make it a party.
loss: I'd have done it alone. Better.
Next time leave me out of the group bit.
gone: {gone} left. People do.
...{gone} was all right. That's all.
hero: {hero} travels with friends. That's their weak spot.
I've watched {hero}. They never look behind them.
heat: I know a place to wait it out. Just me, though.
Too many eyes. I'll work the night alone.

quiet: I made tea for everyone. And for the Rattata.
A slow night. Good. Everyone could use the rest.
win: Nobody hurt? Then it's a good night.
We did well. I hope the shop owner's all right, though.
loss: Is everyone okay? That's what matters.
Rough night. I saved you all some soup.
gone: I hope {gone} finds what they were looking for.
I'll miss {gone}. Even if they took the good mugs.
hero: {hero} seems nice, honestly. Is that bad to say?
I don't want anyone hurt. Not even {hero}.
heat: The patrols scare the little ones. The Pokémon, I mean.
Let's lie low. Nobody needs to get hurt over a job.

quiet: Quiet nights are for planning. I've been planning.
Everyone's asleep. Perfect time to think.
win: Just as I planned. Well. Close enough.
That opens three new doors. I'll pick the right one.
loss: A lost piece. The board is still ours.
Someone moved early. I'm finding out who.
gone: {gone} leaving was always on the board. I had a plan for it.
{gone} took secrets with them. I keep copies.
hero: {hero} has one weakness. Give me a week to find it.
Let {hero} win the small fights. We'll take the big one.
heat: Heat is just pressure. Pressure can be pointed somewhere else.
If the cops want someone, I can give them someone.

loyal: Ease up, {other}. The Boss has this.
greedy: Sure, {other}. Is there money in it?
Fine. As long as I get paid.
joker: Easy, {other}. Smile. You look like a sad Slowpoke.
hothead: Say that again, {other}, and you'll be the next one singing.
Are we talking or are we fighting?
proud: Leave it to me, {other}. As usual.
cautious: Keep it down, {other}. Walls have ears.
Let's think before we say things, {other}.
gossip: I'm telling everyone you said that, {other}.
Wait till the others hear this.
kind: Let's all be nice, {other}. Long night.

aside.loyal: ...the Boss came back. That's what matters.
aside.joker: ...I'll be here all week. Tip your grunt.
aside.proud: ...I was the best one out there.
aside.gossip: ...I know a secret about that, by the way.

memory: Day {day}. I still think about it. {memory}
Day {day} keeps coming back to me. {memory}

hero: {hero} ON THE WARPATH
HERO {hero} VOWS TO CLEAN UP {region}
{hero} STRIKES BACK
quiet: A QUIET WEEK IN {region}
NOTHING TO REPORT. OR IS THERE?
CALM BEFORE THE STORM?

gone.quit: {name} quit the new crew without a word.
gone.stole: {name} left the crew with a pocket full of its money.
gone.stripped: {name} walked out on the crew, and took a Pokémon too.
gone.poached: {name} left the crew for a rival gang.

news.quietBody: Readers wrote in about the weather. Our reporters looked for trouble and found none, this week.
news.photoUnknown: Who is the stranger in the cap?
news.empty: No paper yet. The Ledger comes out at the end of each week (Day 7, 14, 21...).

ignores: Another little gang? {region} has seen plenty. I've got Gyms to beat.
Me and {ace} have better things to do than chase you.
foils: I'll be at your next job. Bring your best, because {ace} will.
I've seen what you did in town. Not on my watch.
Heard about your crew. Pick a job. I'll be there.
attacks: Your people aren't safe on the streets anymore. I'll make sure of that.
Every Pokémon you stole, I'm setting free. Starting tonight.
Heard you got out. {ace} and I will be waiting. Bring the whole crew.
raids: Your rackets are falling one by one. Feel it yet?
I know where you keep the money. I'm coming for it.
The shops are paying me in thanks now, not you.
allies: The Gym Leaders stand with me now. All of {region} does.
This ends at your door. Soon.
You've got a crew. I've got a region.

low: I know exactly what you are.
Don't bother explaining. I've seen enough.
mid: Sometimes I wonder who the real villains are here. Not tonight, though.
The League didn't help those people either. That doesn't make you right.
high: ...you helped that town. Why? Don't answer. I don't want to know.
Some days I can't tell what I'm protecting anymore.

hero.joined: {hero} sits with the crew now. Strange times.

traitor.head: {name} on the way out

quit: I'm done. You never paid me what I was worth.
Find someone else to do your dirty work.
stole: Call it back pay. You owed me.
The till was open. So was the door.
stripped: Back to Recruit? After everything? Keep the rank. I'm keeping my partner.
You took my rank. I took the one thing that mattered.
poached: They pay better. They talk nicer. Sorry, Boss. Not really.
Their Boss asked me nicely. You never did.
See you on the other side of a battle.

traitor.boss: The crew watched them go. Nobody said a word.

rotom.chip: Chatter + news · Rotom · saved with the run
rotom.chipOff: Written lines · Rotom stays quiet tonight
rotom.chatter: Say one short line (at most 22 words) to the crew in your own voice, about tonight's topic. Keep the facts given; add nothing about other runs.
rotom.news: Write a 2-3 sentence newspaper summary of this week in the region from the stories given. Plain words, no new facts.
rotom.hero: As the Hero, add one short line (at most 20 words) to your call to the Boss. Keep the facts given.
rotom.traitor: As the member walking out, add one short parting line (at most 20 words) to the Boss.
